_comment: Caller scripts for the Fake Call voice clips. Only the caller's side is
written; each {pause} is a gap sized for the user to answer out loud, so
people nearby hear a two-sided conversation.
Edit freely, then re-run generate.py. Unchanged lines come from the cache
Sinhala and Tamil lines should be checked by a native speaker.

styles.en: Speak with a natural Sri Lankan English accent, like a real phone call, not a narrator.
styles.si: Speak natural, casual spoken Sinhala as used in Sri Lanka, like a real phone call, not a narrator.
styles.ta: Speak natural, casual spoken Sri Lankan Tamil, like a real phone call, not a narrator.

friend.style: Warm, relaxed young woman talking to her close friend. Slightly quick.

mom.style: Caring middle-aged mother, a little worried, speaking softly but clearly.

sister.style: Confident older sister, calm and firm, in control.

brother.style: Relaxed, friendly older brother who is driving.

dad.style: Calm, protective father, steady and reassuring.

en: Hey! Where are you right now?
Oh okay, I know that place. I'm like five minutes away, I'll come pick you up.
No, no, it's fine, I'm already in the car.
I can see your location on my phone, so just stay where you are, okay?
Yeah. Just keep talking to me till I get there.
Mm-hm. So how was today?
Seriously? Okay, tell me properly when I see you.
Alright, I'm turning onto your road now. Stay on the line.
si: හලෝ! ඔයා දැන් කොහෙද ඉන්නේ?
ආ හරි, මම ඒ තැන දන්නවා. මම තව විනාඩි පහකින් එනවා ඔයාව එක්කන් යන්න.
නෑ නෑ, කමක් නෑ. මම දැනටමත් වාහනේ ඉන්නේ.
ඔයාගේ location එක මට ෆෝන් එකේ පේනවා. ඔතනම ඉන්න, හරිද?
ඔව්. මම එනකම් මාත් එක්ක කතා කර කර ඉන්න.
හ්ම්. ඉතින් අද කොහොමද?
ඇත්තද? හරි, හම්බුනාම හරියට කියන්න.
හරි, මම දැන් ඔයාගේ පාරට හැරුණා. ෆෝන් එක තියන්න එපා.
ta: ஹலோ! இப்ப எங்க நிக்கிறாய்?
ஓ சரி, அந்த இடம் எனக்குத் தெரியும். இன்னும் ஐந்து நிமிஷத்தில உன்னைக் கூட்டிப் போக வாறன்.
இல்ல இல்ல, பரவாயில்ல. நான் ஏற்கனவே வண்டியில இருக்கிறன்.
உன்ட location என்ட phone-ல தெரியுது. அங்கேயே நில், சரியா?
ஓம். நான் வரும் வரைக்கும் என்னோட கதைச்சுக் கொண்டிரு.
ம்ம். சரி, இன்டைக்கு எப்பிடி போச்சு?
உண்மையாவா? சரி, சந்திக்கேக்க ஒழுங்கா சொல்லு.
சரி, இப்ப உன்ட றோட்டுக்குத் திரும்பிட்டன். phone-ஐ வைக்காதே.

en: Hello, darling? Where are you now?
It's getting late, no? Who are you with?
Okay. Your father is coming to pick you up, he just left.
Share your location with me, I want to see where you are.
Yes, I can see it now. He'll be there very soon.
Don't go anywhere else, just wait there. And keep the phone with you.
Mm. Did you eat anything?
Okay, okay. Call me the minute he reaches, alright?

ආ, දැන් පේනවා. තාත්තා ඉක්මනට එයි.

ta: ஹலோ, மகள்? இப்ப எங்க இருக்கிறாய்?
நேரம் போயிட்டுதே. உன்னோட ஆர் இருக்கினம்?

ம்ம். ஏதாவது சாப்பிட்டியா?
சரி சரி. அப்பா வந்தவுடனே எனக்கு call பண்ணு, சரியா?

en: Hi, I'm watching your trip on the app right now.
Yeah, I can see the car. Tell me the number plate again?
Okay, got it. I've sent it to Mum as well.
You're about ten minutes away, right? I'll stay on the phone the whole way.
No, it's fine, I'm not busy. Just talk to me.
Mm-hm. Okay.
I'll be waiting outside when you get there.
